units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1:25">Y. Ber. I, 2ᵈ</cite> top; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 12:13">Gen. R. s. 12</cite> <he>על ידי ש׳</he> in the course of time.

<cite ref="Meilah 6a:19">Meïl. 6ᵃ</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>דלא הוה ש׳ למזרקיה</he> he had not had the time to sprinkle it; (<cite ref="Meilah 6a:19">ib.</cite> <cite ref="U01645"><he>שעות</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 3:4:2">Y. Maasr. III, 50ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>נותנין לו ש׳ כדי וכ׳</he> we allow him an interval of time for cracking &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 3:4:2">Ib.</cite> <he>בתוך כדי ש׳ שנייה</he> within the interval allowed for the second act <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 4:3:5">Y. Sabb. IV, end, 7ᵃ</cite> <he>כאן לשעה כאן לשׁ׳</he> in the one case it means (chafing) for a while, in the other for some time.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 30b:10">R. Hash. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>כדי שיהא שׁ׳ ביום וכ׳</he> that there be time left during the day to offer &c.
Y. Hor. I, 46ᵃ top וש׳ ביניהון וכ׳ and the difference between them is the word time; R. M. says נותנין לו ש׳ וכ׳ we allow him time &c., v. שָׁמַע; a. fr.
